# Pull Request Template

## Description

Brief description of what this PR does and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor (no functional changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and fixed all errors
- [ ] I have run `npm run build` successfully
- [ ] I have run `npm run test` and all tests pass
- [ ] I have run `npm run e2e` and all e2e tests pass
- [ ] I have NOT introduced any new secrets or credentials
- [ ] I have NOT removed or renamed any existing exercise ID, route, or DB column
- [ ] I have added tests for new functionality
- [ ] I have updated documentation if needed
- [ ] My changes are backward-compatible (existing data is preserved)

## Testing

Describe how you tested this change:
- [ ] Manual testing on desktop (Chrome)
- [ ] Manual testing on mobile (Safari iOS)
- [ ] Offline mode tested
- [ ] Multi-account isolation tested (logout → login as different user)

## Risks

List any risks identified and how they're mitigated:
